usedFor: MailerLite holds your subscribers, and Google Meet gets a call when “Schedule a Meeting” follows “Subscriber Added to Group”.

bestTemplate.name: “Subscriber Added to Group” in MailerLite, then “Schedule a Meeting” in Google Meet
bestTemplate.why: Moving a subscriber into a group books a Google Meet, handy for demo or onboarding groups.

watchOut: Only subscribers added to the chosen group fire it, so point the trigger at a group meant for calls.
